tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Find go-to-market software by the job it does. Returns published listings with page and markdown URLs to cite.

query.description: The job in plain words, for example "cold email sending".

category.description: Category or subcategory slug from list_categories or a tool page.

has_mcp.description: Only tools that do (true) or do not (false) ship an MCP server.

has_api.description: Only tools that do (true) or do not (false) have a public API.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging. Use meta.offset plus meta.limit from the previous call. Paging stops at result 200; narrow the query to see more.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Full listing for one tool: summary, features, pros and cons, and dated vendor-verified facts.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: All categories with tool counts. Use a slug as the category filter in search_tools.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Side-by-side of two listed tools: category, pricing tier, and vendor-verified facts (price shown, free plan without a card, official MCP server, public API, native in Clay) each with source URL and checked date, plus practitioner mentions when published. A missing fact is not established; it is never a "no".

tools.name: compare_pricing
tools.description: Dated price comparison of two listed tools, from the vendor-verified plans in the directory: each tool's lowest paid plan, what it is priced per (flat, per seat, per mailbox), how it is billed, and the monthly total for a team of team_size. Prices that are unverified, older than 90 days or changed on the vendor page are left out, and then no comparison is returned. Tools priced per different units or billed differently are stated but not compared. Numbers and sums are computed in code, with the as-of date and the compare page URL to cite.

team_size.description: Seats for a per-seat plan. Default 5.

tools.name: recommend_stack
tools.description: Ranked shortlist per stack slot for a job. job is a slug from /jobs, /list-building or /persona. Job slugs: verify-an-email, find-a-mobile-number, waterfall-enrichment, enrich-a-company-by-domain, find-a-work-email, monitor-buying-signals, linkedin-active-buyers, local-businesses, ecommerce-stores, public-record-industries; persona slugs are listed at /persona. Common phrasings such as "find-a-contact" are resolved and echoed as resolved_from; an unknown slug returns the closest matches. Constraints keep only tools with a vendor-verified match (an unverified tool is left out, not judged lacking). Each tool gets a fact-only reason and a page URL. Deterministic, no AI call.

job.description: Job, list-building or persona slug, for example "verify-an-email".

needs_mcp.description: Only tools with a vendor-verified official MCP server.

needs_api.description: Only tools with a vendor-verified public API.

free_plan.description: Only tools with a vendor-verified free plan that needs no card.

clay_native.description: Only tools vendor-verified as native in Clay.
